name: deck-builder
description: Build talks as HTML decks in your own brand, keep a leave-behind and a mainstage version in sync, and export a PDF plus a PowerPoint file that opens editable in Google Slides. Finds the slides an editable rebuild can't reproduce by comparing renders, and lets you choose per slide: editable, editable with effects baked behind, or a picture. Opinionated defaults, every one surfaced and adjustable.
